subject: general
question: The Gitanjali Literary Prize is awarded in association with which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Gitanjali Literary Prize** was established in **2012 **as a** Franco-Indian literary award.** The **Mohsen Hachtroudi Foundation and CHG Earth Group** founded it (a hotel company in India).
 
• A** Gitanjali Medal, a 15-day literary sojourn, and a translation of the work** are awarded to a Francophone and an Indian author, respectively. 
 
• The French book will be edited in India by an Indian editor and the book in any of the Indian languages will be published by a French editor. 
 
• Many of the major Indian regional languages, as well as any Francophone country, are eligible. All works and genres that relate to the* year's theme are eligible for the prize.*
 
• The prize is named for the **collection of poems Gitanjali (1910) by Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian: Poomani, Agnaadi (Tamil) (winner)**

 
 
• T.K. Rama, V Positive (Malayalam)
 
• Manisha Kulshreshtha, Shigaf (Hindi)
 
 
 
• **Francophone: Lyonel Trouillot, Une Belle Amoure Humaine (Haiti)(winner)**
 
 
• Cécile Oumhani, L’atelier des streson (France)
 
• Khaled Osman, Le Caire a corps perdu (France)
